scope: Manuscript-facing validation-threshold gates for statistical and hardware wording.
non_claims: does not compute confidence intervals or p-values
does not convert short-run rows into performance evidence
does not provide holdout robustness or hardware validation

rows.allowed_wording: Hybrid-b has the lowest descriptive mean final LER in the predeclared software-HIL rows.
rows.upgrade_condition: None; this is the current claim ceiling.
rows.forbidden_inference: Do not state statistical significance, broad robustness, hardware latency or deployment readiness.

rows.allowed_wording: The repeat-expansion command path, row accounting and collector logic were rehearsed.
rows.upgrade_condition: No stronger statement is permitted from short-run rows.
rows.forbidden_inference: Do not use short-run rows as manuscript performance evidence or inferential uncertainty.

rows.current_status: 2 formal scenario row(s) complete with positive paired interval; all-scenario gate still incomplete
rows.allowed_wording: Completed formal scenarios may be described as scenario-level positive paired-interval checks; all-scenario and pooled wording remain planned.
rows.upgrade_condition: Complete all four scenarios with at least 12 and preferably 16 paired repeats, no missing paired rows, and positive predeclared paired-interval lower bounds per scenario plus pooled analysis.
rows.forbidden_inference: Do not claim repeat-expanded advantage, confidence intervals, p-values or robustness before this gate passes.

rows.allowed_wording: Holdout drift families are specified as future validation families.
rows.upgrade_condition: Run the predeclared random-walk, burst/reset and faster-than-window families with missing-run accounting.
rows.forbidden_inference: Do not treat controlled stress diagnostics or anchor scenarios as holdout generalization proof.

rows.allowed_wording: Hardware latency, resource, power and source-vs-board agreement remain measurement targets.
rows.upgrade_condition: Provide board logs, bitstream or RTL hash, source vectors, measured latency/resource/power and source-vs-board agreement.
rows.forbidden_inference: Do not claim FPGA timing closure, resource efficiency, source-vs-board agreement or board-level correction success.
